paragraphs.text: I am seeking a program where careful experimentation is treated as a first-class skill, so I can turn practical model-building experience into a rigorous research practice.
The combination of machine learning foundations and responsible deployment matches my goal of building systems whose limitations can be explained and tested.
I enjoy making service behavior explicit through small interfaces, contract tests, and operational documentation that helps a team respond to failures.
I want to deepen my work on event-driven systems where correctness depends on clear retry, observability, and ownership boundaries.
